name: final-speed-c4

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: g-all: 4 solo and 32 rolling replies, each equal to its solo reply (PASS pin)
g-pass2-rolling: 4 solo and 32 rolling replies, each equal to its solo reply (PASS pin)
g-pass3-rolling: 4 solo and 32 rolling replies, each equal to its solo reply (PASS pin)

notes: Sustained c = 4: four workers in a closed loop, 32 requests of 512 greedy tokens, drafter dspark as booted (docs/HARNESS-NEXT.md section 7). Medians over 3 runs (g-all, g-pass2-rolling, g-pass3-rolling); the span number (decode_c4_tok_s) and the steady window figure are from the same runs. The ladder pairs this record with the newest passing `spec` record of the same engine commit.
